body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a build break in downstream packages by adding the missing `Field.json()` factory helper for the existing `json` field type, and it brings the reference documentation up to date for recently added AI metadata types (`tool`, `skill`) and agent fields (`skills`, `permissions`).

**Changes:**
- Add `Field.json()` helper to match the existing `Field.*()` factory pattern.
- Update reference docs to include `tool`/`skill` metadata types in API/kernel enums and lists.
- Add new AI reference pages for `Tool` and `Skill`, and link them from the AI reference index.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts | Adds `Field.json()` helper for the existing `json` `FieldType`. |
| content/docs/references/kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx | Updates metadata type enums/lists to include `tool` and `skill`. |
| content/docs/references/api/metadata.mdx | Updates metadata API docs to include `tool` and `skill` in type filters. |
| content/docs/references/ai/tool.mdx | Adds auto-generated reference doc for the Tool protocol schema. |
| content/docs/references/ai/skill.mdx | Adds auto-generated reference doc for the Skill protocol schema. |
| content/docs/references/ai/meta.json | Registers the new `skill` and `tool` reference pages in the AI docs section. |
| content/docs/references/ai/index.mdx | Adds cards linking to the new Skill/Tool reference pages. |
| content/docs/references/ai/devops-agent.mdx | Documents agent `skills`/`permissions` fields and clarifies `tools` as legacy fallback. |
| content/docs/references/ai/agent.mdx | Documents agent `skills`/`permissions` fields and clarifies `tools` as legacy fallback. |
</details>
